Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on strategizing inbound lead generation for distressed real estate assets using Google and Meta Ads.
Participants included Raghu, Harsha, and Amit, with roles focused on marketing execution and client relations.
Key topics included keyword research, ad targeting, cost considerations, and the development of a tailored campaign for a persona named David Miller.
Follow-up actions involve creating a detailed cost estimate for a trial campaign and scheduling a call to discuss the proposal with the client.
The team agreed to propose a trial campaign to generate 5-15 qualified leads, using a budget between $1,200 to $1,500, with a focus on competitive pricing to demonstrate value.
